rv.q: The musical offers an entertaining if uneven look at artistic anxiety.
“Tick, Tick…Boom!” revived by the Keen Company in an affectionate, emotionally slight production, is a youthful work by a musical theater composer who never got to grow old.
Tick, Tick...Boom! is that rarest of things, a musical with a soul, our awareness of Larson's real-life fate only deepening its message of carpe diem.

cn.t: Critics find this Keen Company revival an affectionate but emotionally slight tribute to Jonathan Larson's autobiographical early work, capturing the poignancy of a young composer's unfinished journey cut short by his untimely death.
